text.tspan: A pod reaches AWS with no access keys (IRSA / Pod Identity)
blocked for pods: IMDSv2 with hop limit 1
IRSA: IAM OIDC provider + ServiceAccount annotation eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn → AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity.
Pod Identity (newer): agent add-on + association (cluster, namespace, ServiceAccount → role);
the role trusts pods.eks.amazonaws.com, so one role works for many clusters.
